items.title: Trump is not shy of collecting spoils, and the US presidency has plenty
items.description: The US president's most-recent filings indicate he pocketed more than $US2.2 billion last year through ventures ostensibly run by his family.

items.title: Live: Suns take advantage of sloppy Giants as defender cops rib injury
items.description: The GWS backline is dealt a major blow in the opening quarter against the Suns as horrible weather conditions test both sides in Canberra. Follow live.

items.title: Inside this street food market are signs of a crashing currency
items.description: Indonesia's rupiah has fallen to historic lows against the US dollar, causing damage "in most of the economy", analysts say.

items.title: Wildfire forces more than 20,000 people evacuate homes in western Canada
items.description: Thousands of people in British Columbia have been ordered to flee a fast-moving wildfire that nearly doubled in size overnight.

items.title: Infantino denies 'defamatory' affair claims made in British newspaper
items.description: FIFA boss Gianna Infantino dismisses allegations of an affair while working at UEFA as 'categorically untrue'.

items.title: Greens draw betting perk line ahead of gambling showdown
items.description: The Greens are not prepared to vote on the government's gambling legislation, outlining some of their main concerns around "predatory" behaviour.

items.title: Planes in tarmac near miss at Sydney Airport
items.description: A cabin crew member is injured when Jetstar and Qatar Airlines planes almost collide on the tarmac at Sydney Airport.

items.title: 'Very debilitating': Hunter Biden opens up about his father's cancer
items.description: Former US president Joe Biden's prostate cancer has spread to other parts of his body and is causing him pain, even as he continues to speak out on public issues, according to his son Hunter.

items.title: Britain's new PM is redefining populist anger
items.description: Britain's new left-leaning PM Andy Burnham has seized the same public discontent driving Nigel Farage on the populist right but with a very different agenda. As One Nation climbs in the polls, Australia should be paying attention.

items.title: Survivors uncover new evidence in Australia’s contaminated blood scandal
items.description: The 1980s contaminated blood crisis devastated the lives of thousands of Australians who were infected with hepatitis C or HIV. Now, survivor Tristan Stanley, who contracted hep C as a child, has uncovered government documents that raise troubling questions about the scandal.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
